path_base: Paths are relative to the directory containing this manifest.
notes: D01-D08 map to manuscript D1-D8; retain these identities in future experiments.
Null values indicate unverified or unavailable metadata; no development/test split has been assigned.

Titles are taken from supplied gold references. D01-D08 English titles and families follow the existing manuscript; D09-D20 domains and families are cataloguing labels based on document subjects and named organizations. D09-D11 English titles are descriptive translations.
Reference files are indexed as supplied; their presence does not certify annotation independence or graph validity.
Gold hashes identify the supplied reference revisions until explicit gold versions are assigned.
The historical source_pdf field is retained for auditing and may differ from the current filename.
Store generated graphs, legacy metrics and new metrics in experiment directories, not in the source dataset.
D09-D20 are revision additions and have no original manuscript paper_id. Domain and language are separate selection fields.
D09-D20 gold_page_semantics is copied from each supplied reference: pages are inclusive start/end intervals, not enumerated page lists. Evaluators must explicitly support this encoding.
TOC metadata for new documents is based on contents headings detected in the PDF text; null denotes an unverified result rather than absence.

Publication checksums refreshed on 2026-09-18 against current files. Previous manifest gold hashes are retained where changed; this does not establish annotation independence or equivalence to historical experiment snapshots.
